name: Air Fryer Sesame Tofu with Edamame and Brown Rice

components.name: Sesame Tofu

ingredients.name: Extra-firm tofu from pack, pressed before cubing

steps: Press tofu for 20-30 minutes, then cut into cubes; dust lightly with cornstarch, shake off excess, toss with oil and sesame seeds.
Air fry tofu at 195 C in batches for 12-17 minutes until crisp outside and hot through; shake basket midway.
In a small saucepan bubble soy sauce, maple syrup, vinegar, garlic, ginger and sesame oil 2-3 minutes until lightly syrupy; toss hot tofu in sauce just before packing.
Divide tofu, edamame, broccoli and brown rice into four containers; freeze and reheat separately when feasible. The tofu will be less crisp after reheating.

components.name: Brown Rice, Edamame & Broccoli

ingredients.name: Frozen shelled edamame beans, weighed frozen

steps: Wash brown rice and cook in the measured water until tender; cover and rest before fluffing.
Cook frozen edamame according to package instructions, then steam broccoli until tender.

preservationAndReheating: Refrigerate cooked food promptly in shallow covered containers. Target within 2 hours, or within 1 hour if ambient temperatures exceed 32 C.
Refrigerate at 4 C or colder for up to 3-4 days; freeze later-week portions promptly. If freshly prepared salad is included, prepare and store separately.
Reheat previously cooked leftovers to 74 C, stirring and checking the centre. For egg dishes, ensure eggs are completely set before portioning.
Cool cooked rice rapidly and keep refrigerated; avoid leaving rice at room temperature. Reheat rice thoroughly once.
Defrost frozen portions in the refrigerator. Re-crisp pastries, breaded vegetables and air-fried items in an oven or air fryer.
Keep delicate avocado, fresh salad, cold yogurt sauce and unbaked crisp toppings separate. They are generally not freezer-friendly.
